steps.note: Ensure the award is a full award rather than a partial allocation.
Enable eRFX project creation for the conversion flow.
Allow the buyer to add both vendors during event creation.
Provide the required event title for publishing and later History lookup.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.
Add the two vendors named in the case.
Publish the RFQ so vendors can submit quotes.
Verify that the RFQ reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A's RFQ quote of 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor A's quote was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's RFQ quote of 90 through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor B's quote was accepted.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to close before conversion.
Convert the published RFQ, carrying its quotes and participants into the auction.
Publish the converted auction.
Verify that the converted auction is published.
Submit Vendor A's auction bid of 85.
Verify Vendor A's auction bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's auction bid of 88.
Verify Vendor B's auction bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction to close before awarding.
Open the comparison grid for the closed auction bids.
Assert that Vendor A's bid of 85 is ranked L1.
Assert the 10-unit award basis produces a total of 850 for Vendor A.
Allocate all line items to the L1 vendor and submit the award proposal.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver and approve the submitted award with a remark

steps.note: The case requires a separate approver session, which the catalog cannot provide.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase order.
Verify that the PO contains the single awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the completed event's lifecycle state.
Open the History tab where completed events should appear.
Verify that this plan's event moved into History.
